metadata.title: Ethereum leads way as large cryptocurrencies fall - MarketWatch

content.text:
Crypto Update
Ethereum leads way as large cryptocurrencies fall
All large cryptocurrencies were down during U.S. morning trading on Tuesday, with Ethereum Ethereum USD seeing the biggest change, tumbling 4.55% to $2,453.34.
Sui Sui USD fell 4.14% to 71 cents, and Cardano Cardano USD declined 3.57% to 21 cents.
